mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines > 10% YoY and SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases and SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates accommodative monetary policy in the face of inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases, but SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 jobs in a month signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS decreases > 100,000 in 1 month and SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real final sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases > 5% YoY and SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases and UNRATE increases, but SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
